brandbook.motif: Una guía vertical identifica la tarea activa y continúa sin interrupción por el borde izquierdo de su editor expandido. Señala pertenencia y foco de trabajo, no progreso ni métricas.

pages.title: Brand guidelines
pages.summary: Herramienta personal en español que abre directamente al trabajo: una lista compacta, edición contextual y persistencia fiable sin cuentas ni configuración compleja.

pages.summary: Use this divider to introduce a working identity, not a sales story. Pair a short heading with the supported mark on #276044; reserve the remaining space for calm, open composition.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.text: Apply the system to one Spanish task screen: a compact list, contextual editing and clear feedback. Preserve the exact name Atlas Tareas.
examples.title: Guide scope

examples.text: The plan includes Turso persistence and an anonymous session. It excludes registration, external integrations and commercial pages.
examples.title: Product boundary

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Keep the guide in this sequence: intent, identity, typography, color, visual language and applications. Use page numbers as navigation, not decorative counters.

examples.text: Cover and introduction, project intent, voice, logo construction, clear space and misuse.
examples.title: 01–15 · Foundations

examples.text: Typography, hierarchy, layouts, color, graphic elements, icons and an image-free moodboard.
examples.title: 16–29 · Visual system

examples.text: Digital and print design studies, task controls, website, support and closing credits.
examples.title: 30–49 · Applications

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Define Atlas Tareas through its working screen. Prefer a compact list for comparing tasks; avoid empty Kanban columns, date-led agendas, hero sections and summary cards.

examples.text: Atlas Tareas + Nueva tarea → Buscar tareas + Estado → Tarea, Estado, Prioridad, Acciones.
examples.title: Screen sequence

examples.text: Organizar la carpeta de documentos — Pendiente — Media. Show the full title; add no description, date or tag.
examples.title: Content boundary

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Express the supplied product objective rather than inventing a corporate mission. Lead with personal task management and show how the interface keeps editing close to the work.

examples.text: Organiza tus tareas en una sola pantalla.
examples.title: Project objective

examples.text: Create, edit and change status in the list context. Do not turn this objective into claims about productivity gains or guaranteed availability.
examples.title: Practical expression

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Treat clarity, compactness and honest feedback as design criteria from the plan, not invented company values. Every criterion must change a visible interface decision.

examples.text: Use Editar and Eliminar as named actions. Do not replace them with unexplained symbols.
examples.title: Clarity

examples.text: Show Guardando… while waiting and Resultado sin confirmar when the outcome is unknown. Reserve Tarea guardada for confirmation.
examples.title: Honest feedback

examples.text: One row per task, one contextual editor and one filter band. Do not repeat the same task in a summary card.
examples.title: Compactness

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write interface copy in Spanish with short verbs and calm explanations. Name the result and next action; avoid celebration, blame and technical detail that does not help recovery.

examples.text: Nueva tarea · Crear tarea · Guardar cambios · Cancelar.
examples.title: Actions

examples.text: Resultado sin confirmar. Recupera el resultado antes de enviar más cambios para esta tarea.
examples.title: Uncertain outcome

examples.text: Escribe un título de entre 1 y 160 caracteres.
examples.title: Validation

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the logo with one large lockup on white. The symbol is a compact stepped form; the name remains real typography, never embedded into the SVG.

examples.text: Use IBM Plex Sans Semibold beside the three-stroke symbol. Let the name carry recognition and the symbol provide a compact anchor.
examples.title: Atlas Tareas

examples.text: Show one primary lockup, not a wall of alternatives. Keep captions in Work Ink and away from the clear space.
examples.title: Section composition

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: Use the horizontal lockup in the header and the symbol alone for application icons. Do not create stacked initials, circular badges or alternative marks.

examples.text: Place a 32 px symbol beside Atlas Tareas with an 8 px gap. Vertically center it with the 28/32 name.
examples.title: Header lockup

examples.text: At 390 px, use a 24 px name and a 24–28 px symbol. Keep Nueva tarea visible without squeezing the identity.
examples.title: Small-screen lockup

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Render Atlas Tareas in IBM Plex Sans 600 with natural letter spacing. Use Work Ink for the name and Steady Green for the symbol; never stretch either element to fill a container.

examples.text: Atlas Tareas in #232823 with the #276044 symbol on #FFFFFF or #F5F5F2.
examples.title: Light surface

examples.text: Use a white name on #232823 and retain the green symbol inside a #F5F5F2 support square.
examples.title: Dark surface

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Keep external clear space of at least one quarter of the symbol canvas width around the lockup. Measure from the complete lockup, not only the visible strokes.

examples.text: For a 32 px symbol canvas, leave at least 8 px around the lockup. Keep the Nueva tarea button outside this zone.
examples.title: Header spacing

examples.text: For a 16 mm symbol canvas, reserve 4 mm of clear space. Do not let rules, labels or page numbers enter it.
examples.title: Print spacing

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep the mark green on white or pale paper. Colored applications use a canvas-color support surface so all three strokes remain visible without changing their geometry or fill.

examples.text: #276044 symbol + #232823 name on #FFFFFF. Use this pairing for the task header and stationery.
examples.title: Everyday pairing

examples.text: On #276044, place the symbol on #F5F5F2 and set Atlas Tareas in white. Never place green strokes directly on green.
examples.title: Divider pairing

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Preserve the 160 × 160 geometry: three equal 64 × 12 horizontal strokes, each shifted 24 units right and 30 units up. Their measured rhythm signals ordered work, not a progress chart.

examples.text: Stroke origins: (24,104), (48,74), (72,44). All fills are #276044. Keep the square canvas and rectangular ends.
examples.title: Exact construction

examples.text: Use this exact symbol in the Atlas Tareas header, app icon and favicon. Raster versions must retain all three strokes.
examples.title: Reuse

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not rotate, crop, round, outline or animate individual strokes. Do not replace the mark with a checkmark, mountain, initial or performance indicator.

examples.text: Do not label the strokes Pendiente, En curso and Hecha. The symbol identifies Atlas Tareas; it does not report task status.
examples.title: Avoid false meaning

examples.text: No gradients, shadows or stretched lettering. Do not enlarge a cropped stroke into a hero illustration.
examples.title: Avoid decoration

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans throughout. Introduce the type system with real Spanish interface copy, clear alignment and ample line spacing rather than decorative alphabet displays.

examples.text: Busca por título, filtra por estado y edita cada tarea en su contexto.
examples.title: Tus tareas, en una lista

examples.text: Use a 28/32 Semibold heading and 16/24 Regular support copy. Align both to the same left edge.
examples.title: Section treatment

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use one family with a small role-based scale. Keep task titles readable at 16/24, controls at 14/20 and secondary labels at 13/18; compactness comes from layout, not tiny text.

examples.text: Pendiente · Media · Ejemplo
examples.title: Organizar la carpeta de documentos

examples.text: Set the task title in Regular, action labels in Medium and editor headings in Semibold. Keep secondary labels at full ink contrast.
examples.title: Role pairing

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: IBM Plex Sans is the identity and interface family. Distributable files for 400, 500, 600 and 700 are supplied; package them locally with their license rather than relying on a remote font service.

examples.text: En curso · Alta
examples.title: Preparar la lista de la compra

examples.text: Use real accents and punctuation: Título, Prioridad, Aún no hay tareas, ¿Eliminar tarea?
examples.title: Spanish character support

examples.text: If font loading fails, use a system sans-serif fallback. It is a technical fallback, not a replacement identity typeface.
examples.title: Fallback behavior

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use upright 400 for content, 500 for controls and 600 for identity and app headings. Reserve 700 for manual section headings; avoid faux bold, italics and all-caps interface labels.

examples.text: Revisa el título, el estado y la prioridad antes de guardar.
examples.title: Guardar cambios

examples.text: Atlas Tareas: 600. Task title: 400. Editar: 500. Título field label: 500. Let spacing reinforce these differences.
examples.title: Weight contrast

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use smaller IBM Plex Sans for provenance, hints and secondary information. Secondary copy reuses #232823; distinguish it through size, position and weight, not reduced opacity.

examples.text: Ordenar el escritorio · Hecha · Baja
examples.title: Ejemplo

examples.text: Place Ejemplo beside or beneath the title at 13/18. Keep validation hints directly beneath the relevant field.
examples.title: Supporting placement

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Prioritize the app name, task titles and primary action. Use 28/32 for the desktop name, 24/28 on phones, 16/24 for content and 14/20 for buttons inside 44 px targets.

examples.text: Título · Estado · Prioridad
examples.title: Nueva tarea

examples.text: Follow the fields with an expanding error region, Crear tarea and secondary Cancelar. Keep actions visually attached to the form.
examples.title: Editor hierarchy

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: At 1440 px, cap the central surface at 1080 px. Use a 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 px spacing scale. At 768 px, stack row content; at 390 px, use 16 px page margins and stacked filters.

examples.text: Estado: Todos
examples.title: Buscar tareas

examples.text: Use Tarea, Estado, Prioridad and Acciones columns. Give the title the flexible width and place its editor directly below.
examples.title: Desktop structure

examples.text: Target a 60 px header and 104 px filter band. At 390 × 640, keep Nueva tarea, filters and one complete task visible.
examples.title: Phone structure

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use color to separate canvas, work surface and action. Keep large areas quiet; reserve green for the identity, focus and primary controls rather than coloring every task state.

examples.text: Quiet Paper surrounds the white list. Work Ink carries titles. Nueva tarea uses Steady Green with white text.
examples.title: Working composition

examples.text: Use a green field and white heading for this section. Keep the mark on its pale support and avoid decorative color strips.
examples.title: Divider composition

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all six tokens. The five-role palette repeats ink for secondary text; warning and error remain additional semantic colors, not replacements for brand green.

examples.text: Quiet Paper #F5F5F2; Clear Desk #FFFFFF; Steady Green #276044; Work Ink and Secondary Ink #232823.
examples.title: Core palette

examples.text: Warning #805100: Resultado sin confirmar. Error #B42332: invalid fields and Eliminar tarea. Pair every color cue with words.
examples.title: Feedback palette

examples.text: Use #232823 or #276044 for essential control boundaries against light surfaces. Borders must reach 3:1 contrast.
examples.title: Control contrast

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Do not create faint text or essential borders by lowering opacity. Use the supplied pale background as the quiet field; express hover and selection through outlines, weight and explicit labels.

examples.text: Ejemplo stays #232823 at 13/18. Do not turn it into low-contrast gray to make the row feel quieter.
examples.title: Secondary text

examples.text: Use a #F5F5F2 field behind the active context and a solid #276044 guide. Keep focus visibly distinct from selection.
examples.title: Selected context

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Use one vertical green guide to connect the active title to its editor. Keep it continuous, aligned and local; it indicates belonging, not completion, elapsed time or progress.

examples.text: Editar tarea appears immediately beneath Organizar la carpeta de documentos, sharing the row width and left guide.
examples.title: Editing guide

examples.text: Nueva tarea opens the same visual structure before the list. Expand in 160 ms; with reduced motion, reveal it immediately.
examples.title: Creation guide

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple 16–20 px interface icons only as support for named controls. Keep 44 px interactive targets, visible focus and task-specific accessible names. The brandmark is not an action icon.

examples.text: Visible label: Editar. Accessible name: Editar Organizar la carpeta de documentos.
examples.title: Named action

examples.text: Visible label: Eliminar. Accessible name: Eliminar Ordenar el escritorio. Do not rely on a red trash icon alone.
examples.title: Destructive action

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Use no photography, illustration or decorative crops in the app. Task content is the visual focus. Where the guide needs imagery, use clearly framed interface studies with readable text.

examples.text: Show Preparar la lista de la compra in its full row instead of a photograph of groceries.
examples.title: Use content

examples.text: An interface study must retain complete titles, labels and feedback. Do not crop away an error to create a cleaner promotional image.
examples.title: Preserve readability

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the moodboard from working details: pale canvas, white surface, green guide, measured spacing and Spanish copy. Exclude lifestyle scenes, dashboards and glossy product mockups.

examples.text: Pair the three-stroke mark with Atlas Tareas, a 16/24 task title and the Nueva tarea button.
examples.title: Reference cluster

examples.text: Show a connected editor, a visible focus outline and Resultado sin confirmar beside the affected row.
examples.title: Interaction cluster

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: Design studies: translate the same restrained system across digital and print formats. These compositions demonstrate identity use; they add no product routes, services or commercial functions.

pages.summary: Design study: organize posters around a short headline, one enlarged task row and the lockup. Use white space instead of photography; include no launch date, address or promotional offer.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: use a small lockup on pale fabric and a single green mark on the reverse. Preserve the rectangular strokes and clear space; do not introduce merchandise pricing or sales copy.

pages.summary: Design study: adapt the packaging format into a paper sleeve for a printed task specimen. Use the front for identity and the reverse for context; this is not an app export or delivery feature.

pages.summary: Design study: replace pickup wayfinding with entry guidance for the anonymous workspace. Keep session problems near the list and offer a direct-opening action only when embedded access is blocked.

examples.text: Prueba a abrir Atlas Tareas directamente. El espacio puede ser distinto al de la vista integrada.

examples.text: Use Abrir directamente as the explicit recovery action. Do not imply registration or synchronization between browser contexts.

pages.title: Task controls
pages.summary: Design study: keep creation and editing in one in-flow form. Order fields Título, Estado, Prioridad, errors and actions. Use 44 px targets, visible focus and no fixed mobile action dock.

pages.title: Task reference card
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the rewards-card format into a small status reference. Give each status equal space; add no points, streaks, membership levels or completion incentives.

pages.title: Workspace sign
pages.summary: Design study: adapt signage into a presentation workspace label, not a claim of physical premises. Use a large lockup, plain descriptor and generous clear space without arrows or invented addresses.

examples.text: Use ink lettering on a white panel with the green mark to the left. On a green panel, place the mark on its pale support.

pages.summary: Design study: / is the only page. Open directly to the header, filters and compact list. Preserve text and status filters in the URL; use planned server routes and Turso, not a simulated local task store.

examples.text: Exactly three Ejemplo rows: Organizar la carpeta de documentos; Preparar la lista de la compra; Ordenar el escritorio. Never recreate deleted examples.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: reuse the exact mark in app/icon.svg and raster application icons. Keep a pale support surface, square canvas and all three strokes; never substitute a template icon or miniature wordmark.

pages.summary: Design study: use a small lockup at top left, an ink heading and restrained footer. Keep the page mostly white; the vertical guide may connect a heading to its content, never decorate every paragraph.

examples.text: Align the lockup, heading and body to one margin. Use 600 for headings and 400 for copy; put page numbering outside the logo clear space.

pages.title: Business cards
pages.summary: Design study: make an identity card without fabricated people or contact details. Use the lockup on one side and a factual product descriptor on the other; omit URLs and QR codes without a supplied destination.

examples.text: Herramienta de tareas personales en español.

examples.text: Front: green mark and ink name on white. Reverse: short descriptor on pale paper, aligned to the same margin.

pages.title: Task prompt card
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the gift-card format into a non-commercial writing prompt. Show one title line and the available task choices; include no monetary value, redemption code or sharing claim.

examples.text: Escribe un título y elige su estado y prioridad.

pages.title: Document seal
pages.summary: Design study: adapt a packaging seal into a square document label. Use the exact mark on pale paper with clear space; treat it as identification, never as proof of security, approval or completed work.

pages.title: User support
pages.summary: Design study: place help beside the affected row or form, not only in a toast. Distinguish empty lists, errors, conflicts and uncertain outcomes; show a clear recovery action without promising a support service.

brandbook.voice: Breve, directa y tranquila. Usar verbos claros y estados honestos: Nueva tarea, Guardar cambios, Resultado sin confirmar y Recuperar resultado. Evitar lenguaje comercial y explicaciones técnicas salvo cuando sean necesarias para resolver una incidencia.
